findings.title: Default-strategy cases do not enable the required feature
findings.body: When `updateStrategy` is null, this method returns the Keycloak CR before adding `rolling-updates` to its enabled features. The updated operator documentation says the operator fails unless this preview feature is enabled, so the parameterized default-strategy tests exercise an invalid deployment and may fail before reaching their upgrade assertions. Enable the feature for these cases too, or explicitly adapt the tests if the default strategy is intended to work without it.
